messages:
alex: FYI canary in eu-west spiked fncall schema rejects with no route_id -> shows as 'unattributed' in Console and billing. Anyone else?

sam: Yea, saw it. Streaming parser errors abort before route binding so metrics miss route.

jordan: Quick fix idea: emit a tiny telemetry envelope before aborting on validation errors. Fields: reason_code(enum), stage(enum), route_hint_hash(8hex), safe_tag(opt-in). No free text.

maria: Console needs a filter for these and a heatmap. Samples must be redacted and opt-out by default.

ops-bot: Reminder: telemetry fields that touch billing metadata need finance review.

alex: Action plan: 1) emit compact envelope in canary only, 2) ensure pipeline preserves it (<=128B), 3) expose Console filter behind FF, 4) retention 7d and redaction.

sam: I'll prototype envelope and add E2E test to ensure it survives batching.
jordan: I'll mock the Console heatmap and opt-in long retention.
maria: I'll draft a support note for 'Unattributed Validation' and steps for enterprise mapping.

ops-bot: Created TG-1402 (validation envelope), UX-812 (console filter mock), SEC-427 (redaction checklist).

alex: thanks. If you see mismatched cases where route binding ran but telemetry missing, ping here.
